page.title: Paychecks
page.intro: Manage expected pay and review possible paychecks.
page.acknowledgeCreate: I checked my profiles; allow another attempt

manual.heading: Add a paycheck expectation
manual.intro: This is your own expectation, not employer-verified. It will be active without attaching any deposit evidence.

groups.locked: Finish or cancel the open action before closing this group.

profiles.heading: Your paychecks
profiles.emptyBody: Review a possible paycheck below or add an expectation manually. A deposit alone is not a confirmed paycheck.

candidates.heading: Possible paychecks
candidates.intro: Review the deposits before confirming an expectation.
candidates.none: No possible paychecks need review. You can still add a manual expectation.
candidates.dismissedIntro: Dismissal applies to the exact evidence reviewed. Reconsider a possible paycheck to review it again.
candidates.dismissedLocked: Dismissed possible paychecks stay open while a decision is saving.

card.basedOnVariable: Based on {{total}} deposits. Observed history, not an expected range.
card.noWindowActive: No expected window is available. Expected, not guaranteed.
card.noWindowPaused: Paused paychecks have no active expected window.
card.noWindowEnded: Ended paychecks have no active expected window.
card.scheduleNote: To change this schedule, end this profile and create or confirm a replacement. Linked evidence stays with this profile.

facts.sameAmount: The same amount in each deposit
facts.variableAmount: Variable · lower median {{amount}}. This history is not an expected range.

actions.endPrompt: End {{name}}? Its projection will stop. The profile and linked evidence will remain, and you can reactivate it.

evidence.none: No linked deposit evidence. This is your saved expectation.
evidence.edited: Edited since this deposit was linked. The saved expectation is unchanged.
evidence.removePrompt: Remove this paycheck link? The cash-in record will remain in Activity.

receipt.label: Record received paycheck for {{name}}
receipt.heading: Record received
receipt.intro: Link actual cash in to this paycheck. This does not change the saved expectation.
receipt.loadError: Cash in could not be loaded. Cancel and try again.

warnings.dateOutsideWindow: Date is outside this paycheck's expected window. You can still record the actual deposit date.
warnings.amountNeedsReview: Amount needs review. Linking by record ID will not change the saved expectation.
warnings.expectedAmountNeedsReview: Expected amount needs review. Recording the actual amount will not change the saved expectation.
warnings.differsFromFixed: Amount differs from the fixed expectation. You can still record the actual amount.
warnings.expectedRangeNeedsReview: Expected amount range needs review. Recording the actual amount will not change the saved expectation.
warnings.outsideRange: Amount is outside the expected range. You can still record the actual amount.

cashInErrors.amount: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals, up to 9999999999999999.99.

form.manualNote: Create an active profile for your expected paycheck. This is your expectation and is not employer-verified.
form.confirmScheduleNote: Review and accept this schedule unchanged. To use a different schedule, create a paycheck manually.
form.editScheduleNote: The schedule cannot be edited. End this profile and create a replacement to change its schedule. Evidence stays assigned to this profile.
form.variableNote: Observed amounts vary. Enter the minimum and maximum you explicitly accept; observed bounds are not filled in.
form.unsafeAmountNote: This amount could not be loaded with reliable cent precision. Enter the exact amount you accept before saving.
form.submitError: The action could not be completed. Check the page message before trying again.

errors.display_name_invalid: Enter a display name of 1 to 500 characters.
errors.anchor_kind_invalid: Choose a day of month or month end.
errors.anchor_day_invalid: Enter a whole day from 1 to 30, or choose month end.
errors.reference_date_invalid: Enter a valid reference anchor date.
errors.semimonthly_pair_invalid: Choose ordered anchors at least seven days apart, including across February's month boundary.
errors.window_invalid: Enter a whole number from 0 to 3.
errors.amount_mode_invalid: Variable evidence requires an explicit amount range.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter a positive amount with at most two decimals, up to 9999999999999999.99.
errors.range_order_invalid: Maximum amount must be greater than minimum amount.

feedback.loadFailed: Paychecks could not be loaded. Refresh to try again; the displayed information may be out of date.
feedback.uncertainCreate: We could not confirm whether the paycheck was created. Refresh and check the saved profiles before intentionally trying again.
feedback.uncertainWrite: We could not confirm the outcome of this action. Refresh and check the current state before trying again.
feedback.uncertainCreateLoaded: Paychecks loaded. Check the saved profiles before intentionally trying to create another paycheck.
feedback.uncertainReceiptLoaded: Paychecks loaded. Check the linked deposits before intentionally recording another receipt.

notices.dismissed: Candidate dismissed. You can reconsider it below.
notices.receiptRecorded: Paycheck received. Actual cash in is now linked.
notices.receiptRemoved: Paycheck link removed. The cash-in record remains in Activity.

errors.authentication_required: Your session has expired. Sign in again to manage paychecks.
errors.paycheck_not_found: That paycheck is no longer available. Review the current profiles.
errors.candidate_changed: This candidate changed or is no longer available. Review the latest evidence before trying again.
errors.candidate_dismissed: This candidate was dismissed. Reconsider it before confirming.
errors.confirmation_conflict: The evidence changed during confirmation. Review the latest evidence before trying again.
errors.candidate_schedule_mismatch: The candidate schedule cannot be changed. Review it again or create a manual paycheck.
errors.fingerprint_invalid: This candidate can no longer be reviewed. Refresh the candidates.
errors.algorithm_version_invalid: This candidate version is invalid. Refresh the candidates.
errors.name_invalid: Enter a nonblank paycheck name of 500 characters or fewer.
errors.schedule_invalid: Enter a complete, valid paycheck schedule.
errors.timing_invalid: Enter whole timing windows from zero to three days.
errors.amount_invalid: Enter a positive fixed amount or increasing range, with at most two decimal places.
errors.paycheck_not_active: Only an active paycheck can record a new receipt.
errors.receipt_slot_unavailable: That paycheck date is no longer available. Review the refreshed profile.
errors.receipt_source_invalid: Choose either new cash in or an existing cash-in record.
errors.receipt_inflow_invalid: Enter a valid description, positive amount, and date.
errors.receipt_inflow_unavailable: That cash-in record is unavailable or already linked. Review the refreshed records.
errors.receipt_conflict: That receipt changed or was claimed. Review the refreshed paycheck.
errors.receipt_link_protected: Confirmation-history links cannot be removed here.
errors.receipt_date_invalid: The observed date is too far from the selected paycheck date.
errors.request_invalid: Check the form fields and try again.
errors.request_failed: The request could not be completed. Try again.
